Frequently Asked Questions

Simple answers before you travel.

Do you provide one-way taxi services?

Yes. One-way outstation journeys are available. Send us your pickup location and destination for an enquiry.

Do you provide round-trip taxi services?

Yes. We can arrange round-trip journeys according to your travel plans.

Do you provide airport transfers?

Yes. Share your airport, pickup or drop-off location and travel timing.

Can you plan a complete tour?

Yes. Tell us your destination, dates and requirements and we'll help you plan the trip.

Do you travel outside Chandigarh?

Yes. We provide outstation travel across North India and nearby states.

How do I book?

Call or WhatsApp us with your pickup, destination, date, passengers and one-way or round-trip requirement.
